baseline_models.focus_anchor: The idafa أَصْحَابَ ٱلْيَمِينِ joins a relational plural to the right hand or side.
baseline_models.mechanism: The companionship branch makes identity a sustained relation, while the right-side branch supplies its spatial and handed complement; the phrase classifies by attachment rather than by an adjective.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and close association supply the durable group relation carried by أَصْحَابَ.
The right hand, right side, and rightward movement supply the relation's spatial complement.

changed_reading.before: A conventional label: the people of the right.
changed_reading.after: A company constituted by sustained attachment to, or possession of, the right-hand side.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both أَصْحَابَ and ٱلْيَمِينِ carry non-spatial branches inside the focus inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Protective accompaniment combines with auspicious blessing, turning the genitive relation into a condition of being kept in beneficent company.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment contributes keeping by an accompanying care rather than mere co-location.
Blessing and good fortune make the accompaniment auspicious and beneficent.

changed_reading.before: A group occupying the favorable side.
changed_reading.after: Those kept by an accompanying, auspicious protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal يَمِين can activate the oath branch while أَصْحَاب remains a company relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The company is held together not only by side but by a sworn right-hand bond; this is lexically available but competes with the more immediate right-side reading.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship supplies the bonded collective.
The oath and sworn pledge branch supplies the bond that could constitute the company.

changed_reading.after: A company associated through a right-hand oath or sworn bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same relational head first attaches a company to fire and then attaches the focus company to the right. The changing complement sorts durable affiliations or offices, so the focus phrase participates in a contrastive taxonomy rather than standing as an isolated honorific.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship supplies the repeated relational head in the focus.
The right side supplies the focus company's contrasting complement.
The earlier أَصْحَابَ repeats companionship and close association as the same classificatory relation.
Blazing fire supplies the earlier company's opposed complement and assigned sphere.

structural_cues: 74:31 and 74:39 repeat أَصْحَابَ plus a definite genitive, and both clauses are articulated with إِلَّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel heads and opposed complements; I infer a deliberate affiliation contrast. A live alternative is that 74:31 names angelic keepers, so the parallel may contrast an assigned office with a saved company rather than two moral populations.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained name for a fortunate group.
changed_reading.after: One contrasted company whose defining attachment is the right, set against the company assigned to fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding clause constructs a legal-economic field: every self, its acquisitions, and a security held for a right. The opening exception then makes the right-hand or sworn company the plural class outside that ordinary lien, or the class whose lien has been discharged.

activation_trace.role: Companionship converts the exception from isolated persons into a relational company.
The oath branch lets the right hand echo the surrounding pledge register without replacing the side reading.
Totality and enclosure make the collateral rule universal before the exception.
The self or thing itself identifies the individual unit exposed to the lien.
Seeking and acquiring gain supplies what each self has accumulated against itself.
A security held for a right supplies the explicit lien from which the focus company is excepted.

structural_cues: 74:39 begins with إِلَّا and directly completes 74:38; the universal singular self is answered by a plural relational class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, self, acquisition, collateral, and the oath branch; I infer corporate release or surety as the arrow joining them. The exception may instead mark a pledge already redeemed, and the oath sense of يَمِين may remain only a legal echo.

changed_reading.before: A company united by a favorable side or oath.
changed_reading.after: A right-hand or sworn company standing outside, or released from, the ordinary lien created by each self's acquisitions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The continuation places the excepted plural in sheltered gardens and gives it reciprocal speech directed toward offenders. Companionship becomes an active social capacity: the group is gathered, secure, mutually deliberative, and able to examine the condition of the guilty other.

activation_trace.role: Close association supplies the social cohesion enacted by the following plural exchange.
Blessing and good fortune color the company's following location as beneficent rather than merely lateral.
A garden screened by trees supplies the company's sheltered spatial setting.
Mutual questioning turns companionship into reciprocal inquiry rather than passive co-presence.
Guilt and offense supply the contrasted group about whom the right companions inquire.

structural_cues: The unexpressed subject of يَتَسَآءَلُونَ immediately follows the plural أَصْحَابَ, and 74:41 supplies its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the nearest plural group, its location, reciprocal verb, and object; I infer that these actions characterize the right companions. The subject is carried by discourse continuity rather than being lexically restated in 74:40.

changed_reading.before: A blessed collective identified only by status.
changed_reading.after: A sheltered, communicative company whose freedom includes mutual inquiry into the offenders' path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offenders describe another form of togetherness: entering a liquid or affair with those already entering it. Against that contagious co-immersion, the focus companionship can be read as stable association with a rightward orientation rather than absorption into a surrounding current.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association supplies the focus's durable alternative to imitative togetherness.
Right side and rightward movement give the stable company a discriminating orientation.
Entering water supplies the material image of a group current that engulfs participants together.
Entering talk or an affair maps the water image onto collective discourse and conduct.

structural_cues: 74:45 repeats the same root as verb and participle around explicit مَعَ, foregrounding participation with a peer group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-entry, its liquid branch, and explicit withness; I infer a social-current mechanism contrasted with right companionship. The live alternative is the ordinary sense of participating in talk, without a sustained liquid metaphor.

changed_reading.after: A rival mode of togetherness: remaining attached to a rightward orientation instead of being carried into whatever group-current others enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge is tied to acquisition, and the ensuing answers name failed vertical, social, and accounting relations: no worship, no feeding of the abased, and denial of recompense. By contrastive inference, the right company's status becomes legible as a pattern of relational earnings rather than arbitrary privilege.

activation_trace.role: Companionship makes the focus class relational and able to bear a shared conduct profile.
The side of right and rightful force supplies a normative, not merely spatial, orientation.
Acquiring gain establishes the deed-and-consequence frame for the later confession.
Prayer as binding worship supplies the vertical relation the offenders lacked.
Feeding another supplies the outward material relation the offenders withheld.
Abasement and destitution identify the vulnerable recipient of the withheld relation.
Contradiction of truth supplies the offenders' failed epistemic relation to judgment.
Accounting and recompense supply the denied consequence that gathers the conduct into one ledger.

structural_cues: The answers in 74:43-46 follow the right companions' question and sit downstream of 74:38's acquisition-backed pledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition and the offenders' causal confession; I infer that the contrasted practices help profile the right company. Negating the offenders' failures does not logically prove that every right companion performs each exact inverse.

changed_reading.before: A privileged class exempted without an internal mechanism.
changed_reading.after: A right-related company whose exception is narratively associated with worship, provision for the abased, and truth toward accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intercession is literally an added joining, yet that joining gives the offenders no benefit. This limits the protective-accompaniment baseline: saving company cannot mean any adjacency whatever, but a constitutive right relation distinguishable from a late external pairing.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the focus model that the failed intercession qualifies.
Auspicious blessing distinguishes the focus relation from neutral or ineffective proximity.
Benefit opposed to harm is explicitly denied to the offenders' added relation.
An intercessor joining another supplies the failed late form of accompaniment.

structural_cues: 74:48 follows the offenders' confession and certainty threshold, whereas the right company is already located and speaking in 74:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ineffective joining and the focus's protective accompaniment; I infer a distinction between prior constitutive affiliation and later added advocacy. The failure may be specific to these offenders rather than a general rule about timing.

changed_reading.before: The group is protected simply because something accompanies it.
changed_reading.after: Its protective company is a prior, constitutive right relation, not an ineffective advocate attached after the decisive course is complete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames the focus with advance or delay, then depicts turning one's side away and fleeing, before reopening willing remembrance. Because the focus right-side branch includes rightward movement, 'right' becomes a maintained response-direction and not only a fixed location.

activation_trace.role: Sustained association makes the directional response stable enough to constitute a company.
Rightward movement activates a dynamic orientation inside the focus complement.
Advancing forward supplies the positive movement option immediately before the pledge and exception.
Delay to a later point supplies the opposed movement option.
Turning one's side away supplies bodily misorientation from the reminder.
Flight supplies the accelerated completion of that wrong-way response.
Bringing something back to presence supplies the alternative movement toward the reminder.

structural_cues: The advance-or-delay alternative occurs at 74:37, two ayat before the focus; turning and flight occur at 74:49-51, followed by chosen remembrance at 74:55.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed motions and a focus branch that includes rightward movement; I infer a directional response-axis across them. A live alternative keeps ٱلْيَمِينِ as a static side or rank and treats the motion vocabulary independently.

changed_reading.before: Companions assigned to a fixed right side.
changed_reading.after: Companions who maintain a rightward or forward response instead of turning their side, delaying, and fleeing remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distributed material grammar runs from outer wrapping and purified clothing through a shield-like garden to warding and a preserving cover. That sequence gives protective accompaniment and blessing a tactile envelope: the right company is carried within ordered shelter, not merely placed at a coordinate.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the focus anchor for the recurring shelter images.
Blessing and good fortune make the shelter beneficent rather than merely concealing.
An outer wrap over an inner garment opens the surah with a literal enclosing layer.
Clothing, also usable for the self, makes the enclosing layer morally and personally legible.
Purity as removal of stain makes protection an ordered, cleansed envelope rather than mere cover.
A protective shield activates the immediate garden setting as shelter around the company.
Warding off harm supplies the closing protective function.
A cover that preserves what it covers completes the shelter sequence.

structural_cues: The covering field spans the opening address and clothing command, the focus's immediate garden continuation, and the paired closing predicates in 74:56.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring cover, cleansing, shield, warding, and preserving images; I infer that they converge on the focus's protective-accompaniment branch. Their grammatical subjects differ, so the convergence may be atmospheric rather than a direct definition of the group.

changed_reading.before: An abstractly blessed and protected group.
changed_reading.after: An accompanied company carried through a purifying, sheltering, harm-blocking envelope.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare death-by-right-side branch instead of the ordinary right-side branch. It remains anchored in the focus's exact يَمِين and is sharpened by certainty arriving before the scene of garden company. Because the packet's ي ق ن branch says certainty, not death, downstream prose should render this only as a mortuary threshold echo, never as a lexical identification of ٱلْيَقِينُ with death.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus يَمِين carries a branch in which dying is imaged by laying the dead person on the right side.

activation_trace.role: Being laid on the right side in death supplies the branch-distant mortuary image.
Companionship keeps the image attached to a collective transition rather than an isolated corpse.
Coming or arrival supplies the threshold movement in the offenders' final clause.
Fixed knowledge with doubt removed supplies the named threshold without itself asserting death.
The screened garden supplies the post-focus destination that makes the threshold image readable.

changed_reading.before: A company on the favorable right side.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a company whose right-side placement resonates with passage through the certainty threshold into garden company.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a technical hide-with-hair branch of ص ح ب and a cutting branch of ج ر م, both distant from the surface nouns. It remains anchored in the focus root and in the direct contrast with ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for cohesion versus severance, not as a translation or etymological claim about either group.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus أَصْحَابَ can retain the branch image of a hide whose hair or wool is left closely attached.

activation_trace.role: A hide kept with its hair attached supplies a material image of retained adhesion for the company.
The right side keeps the retained-layer analogy attached to the focus complement.
Cutting and severance supply a material counter-image for the offenders contrasted with the attached company.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, a layer kept attached on the right, contrasted with those figured as cut or severed.

strongest_changes: The immediate 74:38 sequence turns the phrase into a plural exception from universal acquisition-backed collateral, with a live oath or surety echo in يَمِين.
The repeated أَصْحَابَ plus complement in 74:31 and 74:39 makes the right company one contrasted affiliation rather than an isolated title.
74:40-48 turns the group into a sheltered questioning community and distinguishes durable right companionship from contagious co-immersion and ineffective late joining.
The advance, turning, flight, and remembrance sequence activates right as an enacted response-direction as well as a side.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed several competing modes of attachment: service to fire, right companionship, wading with peers, and an intercessor joining another. The focus branches also let legal and protective sequences activate sworn bond and shelter readings without forcing them into the dominant spatial model.
remaining_uncertainties: The exception may mean never held as collateral, released collateral, or a distinct mode of satisfying the pledge.
The oath, rightful-force, and mortuary branches of ي م ن remain live but secondary to the ordinary right-hand or right-side branch.
The offenders' negative confession profiles the contrast, but it does not prove that every right companion instantiates each exact inverse practice.
The protective-cover sequence spans different grammatical subjects and may be a distributed atmosphere rather than a direct definition of the focus group.
